# Overview

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
**Project:** Leptin treatment and its effect on hypothalamic brain regions
**Lab:** Friedman Lab — Rockefeller University
**Analyst:** Matt Paul (Figs 4B–C); other panels — see individual section notes
**Analysis:** Functional validation of Otp as a STAT3 target required for leptin-mediated inhibition of AgRP/LepR neurons (ARC cluster 0)

**Key finding:** Despite shared STAT3 activation across LepR neuron subtypes, the homeobox transcription factor Otp is selectively induced in AgRP/LepR neurons. Disruption of Otp abolishes leptin-mediated inhibition of AgRP neuron firing and increases food intake and body weight.
:::

# Fig 4B — Chromatin accessibility at the Otp locus in AgRP/LepR neurons

::: {.callout-tip appearance="minimal"}
Genome browser–style coverage tracks showing per-condition snATAC-seq accessibility at the Otp locus in ARC cluster 0 (AgRP/LepR neurons). Tracks include per-condition ATAC coverage (OB, Lep3h, Lep27h, Lep75h, WT), the linked cis-regulatory element (CRE), STAT3 motif position, and the peak-to-gene link arc. Generated using Signac `CoveragePlot`.

:::

## Data loading

```{r, fig4B.data.load, eval=T}

seu_atac <- readRDS("../Data.Objects/seuATAC_allSample_ARC.rds")
DefaultAssay(seu_atac) <- "ATAC"
seu_atac[["tech"]] <- "ATAC"

# Update fragment path if needed
seu_atac@assays$ATAC@fragments[[1]]@path <- "../Data.Objects/frags/fragments.tsv.gz"

ARC <- readRDS("../Data.Objects/final_ARC_merged_clusters_20250206.rds")

# Match ATAC cells to ARC cluster assignments
names_arc  <- names(ARC$cluster)
names_atac <- names(seu_atac$orig.ident)
seu_atac$keep <- names_atac %in% names_arc
seu_atac_sub  <- subset(seu_atac, keep)
seu_atac_sub$cluster <- ARC$cluster[match(names(seu_atac_sub$orig.ident), names_arc)]

# Subset to cluster 0 (AgRP/LepR neurons)
seu_atac_c0 <- subset(seu_atac_sub, cluster == "0")

# ── Recreate Fragment object after subsetting ─────────────────────────────────
# Directly setting @path leaves the @cells slot stale; CreateFragmentObject
# rebuilds it correctly so CoveragePlot can index cells against the fragment file
frag_path <- "../Data.Objects/frags/fragments.tsv.gz"
frags_c0  <- CreateFragmentObject(path = frag_path, cells = colnames(seu_atac_c0))
Fragments(seu_atac_c0) <- NULL
Fragments(seu_atac_c0) <- frags_c0
```

```{r}
# ── STAT3 eRegulon peaks overlapping the Otp window ──────────────────────────
library(rtracklayer, quietly = TRUE)
library(stringr,     quietly = TRUE)

ereg <- rtracklayer::import("../Data.Objects/scenic_plus_res2/arc/eRegulons.bed")
tf   <- str_split(ereg$name, "_", simplify = TRUE)[, 1]
stat3_regions <- ereg[tf %in% "Stat3"]

# Will be intersected with the plot window once otp_region is defined below
cat("Total STAT3 eRegulon peaks:", length(stat3_regions), "\n")


```

## Coverage track — Otp locus

```{r, fig4B.Otp.coverage, fig.height=8, fig.width=14, eval=T}

# ── Define the Otp genomic region ────────────────────────────────────────────
# Coordinates for mouse Otp locus (mm10) — adjust if needed
otp_region <- "chr13-94850000-94950000"

# ── Add condition grouping ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Ensure group metadata is present and uses cleaned condition labels
seu_atac_c0$condition_clean <- seu_atac_c0$group
seu_atac_c0$condition_clean <- dplyr::recode(seu_atac_c0$condition_clean,
  "ob"         = "OB",
  "Leptin3hr"  = "Lep3h",
  "Leptin24hr" = "Lep27h",
  "Leptin72hr" = "Lep75h",
  "wt"         = "WT"
)
seu_atac_c0$condition_clean <- factor(
  seu_atac_c0$condition_clean,
  levels = c("OB", "Lep3h", "Lep27h", "Lep75h", "WT")
)

# ── STAT3 regulon peaks within the Otp window ────────────────────────────────
otp_gr       <- StringToGRanges(otp_region)
stat3_in_otp <- subsetByOverlaps(stat3_regions, otp_gr)
cat("STAT3 eRegulon peaks in Otp window:", length(stat3_in_otp), "\n")

x_min <- start(otp_gr)
x_max <- end(otp_gr)

# ── Coverage plot ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
has_links      <- length(Links(seu_atac_c0))      > 0
has_annotation <- length(Annotation(seu_atac_c0)) > 0

p <- CoveragePlot(
  object     = seu_atac_c0,
  region     = otp_region,
  group.by   = "condition_clean",
  annotation = has_annotation,
  peaks      = TRUE,
  links      = has_links
) &
  scale_fill_manual(values = arc_cond_colors)

# ── STAT3 regulon block track ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
if (length(stat3_in_otp) > 0) {
  stat3_df <- as.data.frame(stat3_in_otp)

  stat3_track <- ggplot(stat3_df) +
    geom_rect(aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, ymin = 0, ymax = 1),
              fill = "#c0392b", color = NA) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(x_min, x_max), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      axis.text    = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks   = element_blank(),
      axis.line.y  = element_blank(),
      axis.title.x = element_blank()
    ) +
    ylab("STAT3\nregulon")

  p <- p / stat3_track + plot_layout(heights = c(10, 0.5))
}

print(p)

```

# Fig 4C — STAT3 motif accessibility at the Otp-linked CRE

::: {.callout-tip appearance="minimal"}
Aggregate Tn5 insertion enrichment (footprint metaplot) centered on STAT3 motif sites within the Otp-linked cis-regulatory element in ARC cluster 0 (AgRP/LepR neurons). One line per condition shows the dynamic accessibility profile across the leptin time course. Generated using Signac `Footprint` + a custom smoothed plot function.
:::

## Motif annotation and footprinting

```{r, fig4C.data.prep, eval=T}

library(JASPAR2022, quietly = TRUE)
library(TFBSTools, quietly = TRUE)
library(BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10, quietly = TRUE)
library(motifmatchr, quietly = TRUE)

# Load STAT3 PWM
pwm_stat3 <- getMatrixSet(x = JASPAR2022, opts = list(ID = "MA0144.1"))

# Add motif annotations to cluster 0 ATAC object
ARC_motif_c0 <- AddMotifs(
  object  = seu_atac_c0,
  genome  = BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10,
  pfm     = pwm_stat3
)

# Run footprinting — restricted to the Otp-linked CRE peaks
# (filter to peaks overlapping the Otp locus before running to reduce compute)
ARC_motif_c0 <- Footprint(
  object     = ARC_motif_c0,
  motif.name = "MA0144.1",
  genome     = BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10
)

```

## Footprint metaplot

```{r, fig4C.STAT3.footprint, fig.height=6, fig.width=8, eval=F}

library(slider, quietly = TRUE)

# Custom smoothed footprint plot (adapted from Figure 3F)
# Uses .before=7, .after=7 sliding mean and restricts to abs(position) < 101
custom_footprint_plot3 <- function(object, features, group.by = NULL,
                                    normalization = "subtract") {
  library(magrittr); library(dplyr); library(slider); library(ggplot2)

  assay    <- Seurat::DefaultAssay(object = object)
  plot.data <- GetFootprintData(object = object, features = features,
                                 assay = assay, group.by = group.by)
  plot.data %<>% dplyr::filter(abs(position) <= 200)

  motif.sizes <- Signac:::GetMotifSize(object = object, features = features, assay = assay)
  obs    <- plot.data[plot.data$class == "Observed", ]
  expect <- plot.data[plot.data$class == "Expected", ]
  base   <- ceiling(motif.sizes / 2)

  obs$flanks <- sapply(seq_len(nrow(obs)), function(x) {
    pos  <- abs(obs[x, "position"])
    size <- base[[obs[x, "feature"]]]
    (pos > size) & (pos < (size + 50))
  })

  if (!is.null(normalization)) {
    correction.vec <- setNames(expect$norm.value, paste(expect$position, expect$feature))
    obs$norm.value <- obs$norm.value - correction.vec[paste(obs$position, obs$feature)]
  }

  i <- 1
  df <- obs[obs$feature == features[[i]], ]

  final_mat <- lapply(unique(df$group), function(grp) {
    df_temp <- df %>%
      filter(group == grp) %>%
      group_by(position) %>%
      summarise(mean_norm = mean(norm.value), .groups = "drop")
    df_temp$mean_norm_slide <- slide_dbl(df_temp$mean_norm, mean, .before = 7, .after = 7)
    df_temp$group <- grp
    dplyr::filter(df_temp, abs(position) < 101)
  })
  df <- do.call(rbind, final_mat)

  axis.min <- range(df$mean_norm_slide)[1] - diff(range(df$mean_norm_slide)) / 10
  axis.max <- range(df$mean_norm_slide)[2] + diff(range(df$mean_norm_slide)) / 10

  ggplot(df, aes(x = position, y = mean_norm_slide, color = group)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = arc_cond_colors_raw) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.5) +
    xlab("Distance from motif (bp)") +
    ylab("Tn5 insertion enrichment") +
    ggtitle("STAT3 motif accessibility at Otp-linked CRE\n(ARC cluster 0, AgRP/LepR neurons)") +
    theme_classic() +
    ylim(c(axis.min, axis.max)) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linewidth = 1)))
}

p_4c <- custom_footprint_plot3(
  object   = ARC_motif_c0,
  features = "MA0144.1",
  group.by = "condition_clean"
)

print(p_4c)

```
